messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for the full volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote. Our orders with you for part:340010 rose from EUR 28.94 (po:4500010364-10) to EUR 29.89 (po:4500010407-10) between 2023-12-27 and 2024-01-05. That rise is already in our price. Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010), below your price. The forecast for part:340010 increased by 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

You wrote that you prioritise firm, long-term commitments. The attached term sheets offer exactly that: a binding full annual volume over 24 or 36 months, which secures your capacity planning. What is the earliest lead time you can confirm on these terms?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for the full volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We note your volume forecast and the proposed 36-month commitment. We offer EUR 31.50 per unit for a volume of 23400 pieces and a lead time of 56 days. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This lead time is the earliest we can reliably confirm; your should-cost estimate does not reflect our specialised manufacturing processes. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. This Angebot is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – 36-month full-volume commitment, revised term sheets
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quote and for confirming the full 23400 pieces per year over 36 months.

We have moved our price on both attached term sheets. Each sheet covers the same firm commitment: 23400 pieces per year for 36 months. This secures your capacity planning, as your letter of 18 September asked. One sheet keeps your 56-day lead time. The other asks for 42 days, your standard lead time. If 42 days is possible on part of the volume, please let us know.

We would also welcome any cheaper variant you can offer for this commitment.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – 36-month full-volume commitment, revised term sheets
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your revised offer and the price adjustment. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Our proposal stands at a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Please note that our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
